phrase.en: Gates says industry downplays AI risks
MIT TR asks what now after thresholds
phrase.zh: MIT科技评论追问阈值之后

gloss.en: Bill Gates warns AI's dangers are underestimated, sparking urgent debate.
gloss.zh: 比尔·盖茨警告AI风险被低估，引发紧迫讨论。

why_now.en: You track AI ethics: Gates' interview and MIT Tech Review analysis push the conversation beyond hype.
why_now.zh: 你关注AI伦理：盖茨访谈和《麻省理工科技评论》分析将讨论推向深入。

phrase.en: AI fake doctors deceive Taiwan elders
OpenAI disrupts Russian AI influence campaign

gloss.en: AI fakes spread from Taiwan seniors to Russian influence campaigns.
gloss.zh: AI造假从台湾老年人蔓延到俄罗斯影响行动。

why_now.en: You follow AI's societal impact: two concrete cases show manipulation reaching vulnerable populations.
why_now.zh: 你关注AI社会影响：两个案例显示操纵触及弱势群体。

phrase.en: AI guides assembly and disassembly workers

phrase.zh: 多智能体自主科学数据探索

gloss.en: AI assists workers and scientists, from assembly to data exploration.
gloss.zh: AI辅助工人和科学家，从装配到数据探索。

why_now.en: You study embodied AI: these papers show AI guiding physical tasks and scientific discovery in practice.
why_now.zh: 你研究具身AI：这些论文展示AI在实践中的物理任务和科学发现引导。
